children: Toyoda Gosei will invest about 5.76 billion Indian rupees, or 9.3 billion yen, to build a new auto parts plant in Maharashtra, India. According to Sina Finance, the plant will produce automotive interior and exterior parts such as bumpers and instrument panels, as well as airbags and steering wheels. The new factory is scheduled to begin operations in the first half of 2029.

title: Toyoda Gosei to Build New Auto Parts Plant in Maharashtra for 9.3 Billion Yen
